title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Convert Word (.docx) To PDF (.pdf) within BC (No control add-in and APIs)
summary: Converting Word documents to PDF format within Business Central can be achieved using the built-in ConvertWordToPdf procedure from codeunit 9651 without requiring control add-ins or external APIs. The post demonstrates two practical approaches: converting attached Word documents and uploading documents for conversion, with complete source code examples.
key_points: Use codeunit 9651 Document Report Mgt. and its ConvertWordToPdf procedure to convert DOCX files to PDF
No control add-ins or external APIs required for the conversion functionality
Can integrate conversion into page extensions to add Word-to-PDF conversion actions
The method handles document attachments through temp blob objects for streaming

quotes.text: codeunit 9651 "Document Report Mgt." -> procedure ConvertWordToPdf(var TempBlob: Codeunit "Temp Blob"; ReportID: Integer)
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the exact system procedure developers should use for Word-to-PDF conversion without external tools
